goal_check: Test whether explicit shrinkage of model residual weights toward zero preserves useful market anchoring and reduces the instability observed in H13 and H14.

adaptive_origin_disclosure.interpretation: H14 retained no effective market exponent in first64/all92 and did not improve on the equal ensemble. H17 is adaptive and its reused late28 result cannot be confirmation.

allowed_data.reader: unbuffered exact four-VALID-block reader that stops before every TEST byte
allowed_data.required_alignment: exact rcDate, race_id, entry_id, winner label, and q identity across member blocks

chronology.first64_dates: refit selected ridge and evaluate once on late28
chronology.all92_dates: refit selected ridge deployment weights for future prospective scoring

model.name: H17 ridge-regularized convex market-residual log pool
model.objective: mean race winner negative log likelihood + (lambda/2)*sum_m w_m^2
model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize SLSQP with analytic gradient including lambda*w

ridge_selection.daily_loss: mean winner negative log likelihood per date
ridge_selection.selection_rule: one-standard-error rule: find minimum next20 mean NLL; among lambdas whose mean NLL is at most min plus the standard error of the minimum-lambda candidate's 20 daily NLL values, choose the largest lambda; exact ties also choose larger lambda
ridge_selection.fit_count_derivation: 12 first44 candidate fits + 1 selected-lambda first64 fit + 1 selected-lambda all92 fit

locked_historical_outputs: lambda grid with first44 optimizer results and next20 daily/aggregate NLL
first64 and all92 weights, weight sums, market exponents, optimizer traces
late28 DeltaLL versus q, equal ensemble, H13 first64, and H14 first64
late28 runner Brier, fixed 10-bin ECE, top1, probability sum error
day-block 10,000-replicate sensitivity CI and paired day sign-flip p
weight stability L1 and cosine diagnostics

claim_limits.prospective_requirement: A separate result-blind scorer protocol and immutable prestart output are required; no backfill after a race starts.
